title: 第9章 今日起戒色异象第10章 山脉深处血衣亲传
slug: 从暮年娶妻到长生不死
lines: 回到账房，沈云泡上一壶上好的绿茶，打开九转白玉糕的盒子，满室生香。
迫不及待的品尝了一口，细腻清爽的口感在舌尖散开，好几重味道，逐层递进，带给味蕾重重刺激，唇齿留香。
不愧九转之名，不知道怎么做的。
两世为人，沈云心中能媲美此味道的美食，只有通宵饿了两天后尝到的第一口泡面。
一口糕点，一口好茶，人生胜在享受。
【享茶香，品美糕，福报+1】
享受退休生活不只是按按摩，洗洗脚，沈云看着古卷提示，自己之前还是太浅薄了。
身心愉悦便是享受，源自于身体和心理上的满足。
年轻人那般在潜龙山脉打生打死，抢夺机缘固然惊险刺激，但不适合他这个老人家。
意犹未尽的吃完后，沈云起身落下门栓。
坐在椅子上看似假寐，实则运转起了紫雷呼吸法。
小成之前运转呼吸法身上总是迸发电光，不容易遮掩。
现在电光消失，交织在体内，适合在账房修行。
几日下来，沈云越发体悟到呼吸法的玄妙，怪不得大家族将其视为核心。
若静，呼吸法调动气血和电芒深层次蕴养体魄。
若动，调动起来的气血和电芒，加持于肉身之上，实力得到增长。
沈云现在不想打架，只想呼吸法再进一步，炼化气血丹更快些。
小成的呼吸法约莫两天能炼化一枚血元丹。
想要彻底改变衰老的情况，要到血海境延续寿命才行，养体远远不够。
入阶修士也只能长命百岁。
留给沈云的时间看似宽裕，实际上很紧张。
越老他的修行速度不会越快，气血衰败下只会越慢。
下一个目标，呼吸法大成。
小成后，紫电呼吸法运转一个多时辰，才能获得一点熟练度。
一日上值的时间，硬生生被沈云增长了三点熟练度，省了三点福报。
夜间修行约莫还能再增长两点，速度很可观。
不知道没有古卷的人修行起来是怎样的？
想来未必如此，古卷自有神异，沈云得到之后除非瓶颈，进度未曾有过回退。
普通人修行，三五日不练便会生涩退步。
而他一证永证，是个无形好处。
今日天色阴沉，暗的比往日早，账房中没有点蜡烛。
沈云张开眼的瞬间迸发电光，观暗室如白昼。
“不需要一个月，呼吸法必能大成！”
有古卷相助，该享受时候享受，该修行时修行。
沈云不像其他人，会受困于瓶颈静止不前，需要外出历练拼搏寻求突破。
福报点前无瓶颈！
几日时间，已经吃了三枚血元丹，三百两银子。
存货够突破养体二阶，但之后没有丹药相助，想进步就困难了。
“赚资源的法子，最好是有门槛，入门困难，技术含量高的。”
沈云心中隐隐有了想法。
唯有修行百艺中炼丹、炼器、制作符石之类的辅修符合要求。
content_en:
Returning to the accounting room, Shen Yun brewed a pot of good green tea and opened the box of Jiuzhuan White Jade Cake, filling the room with fragrance.
I couldn't wait to take a sip, and the delicate and refreshing taste spread on the tip of my tongue. Several flavors, layer by layer, stimulated my taste buds and left a fragrance on my lips and teeth.
It lives up to the name of Nine Transformations, I don’t know how to do it.
Having lived in two lifetimes, the only food that could rival this taste in Shen Yun's mind was the first bite of instant noodles he tasted after two days of starving all night.
A bite of cake, a sip of good tea, life is about enjoying.
[Enjoy the fragrance of tea, taste delicious cakes, and receive +1 blessing]
Enjoying retirement life is not just about getting a massage and washing your feet. Shen Yun looked at the ancient scrolls and reminded him that he was still too shallow before.
Physical and mental pleasure is enjoyment, which comes from physical and psychological satisfaction.
It is thrilling and thrilling for a young man to fight for life and death in the Qianlong Mountains for opportunities, but it is not suitable for an old man like him.
After finishing his meal, Shen Yun stood up and lowered the door bolt.
Sitting on the chair, it looks like he is pretending to be asleep, but in fact, he is running the Purple Thunder Breathing Technique.
Xiao Cheng used to perform the breathing method and his body would always emit light, which was not easy to cover up.
Now that the electric light has disappeared and is intertwined within the body, it is suitable for practicing in the accounting room.
After a few days, Chen Yun realized more and more the mystery of the breathing method. No wonder the big family regarded it as the core.
If you are still, the breathing method mobilizes Qi, blood and electric light to deeply nourish the body.
If it moves, the mobilized energy, blood and electric light will bless the physical body, and its strength will increase.
Chen Yun doesn't want to fight now, he just wants to take the breathing method a step further and refine the Qi and Blood Pill faster.
Xiao Cheng's breathing method can refine a blood essence pill in about two days.
If you want to completely change the aging situation, you have to go to the Blood Sea Realm to extend your life. Nurturing your body is far from enough.
Novice monks can only live a hundred years.
The time left for Shen Yun seemed to be ample, but in fact it was very tight.
The older he gets, the faster his cultivation speed will be, and the slower it will be as his Qi and blood decline.
The next goal is to master the breathing technique.
After completing it, the Purple Lightning Breathing Technique can be run for more than an hour to gain some proficiency.
In one day of duty, Shen Yun suddenly gained three points of proficiency and saved three points of good fortune.
Night practice can probably increase it by two points, which is a very impressive speed.
I wonder what it would be like for people who don’t have ancient scrolls to practice?
This may not be the case in the future. The ancient scrolls have their own magic. After Shen Yun obtained them, his progress has never been set back except for bottlenecks.
Ordinary people will become sluggish and regress if they don't practice for three to five days.
And his once-certified certification lasts forever, which is an intangible benefit.
The sky was gloomy today, getting darker earlier than usual, and there were no candles lit in the accounting room.
The moment Chen Yun opened his eyes, lightning burst out, and the dark room seemed like daylight.
"It doesn't take a month to master the breathing method!"
With the help of ancient scrolls, you can enjoy when you should enjoy it and practice when you should practice.
Shen Yun is not like other people who are stuck in bottlenecks and need to go out to experience and work hard to find breakthroughs.
There is no bottleneck before the blessing point!
In a few days, he had already eaten three Blood Essence Pills and three hundred taels of silver.
The inventory is enough to break through to the second level of body nourishment, but without the help of elixirs, it will be difficult to progress.
"The best way to earn resources is to have a threshold, difficult to get started, and have high technical content."
Shen Yun had a vague idea in his mind.
Only minor skills such as alchemy, weapon refining, and rune-making among the various arts can meet the requirements.
